smell_validity.evidence: Every remote operation must implement one wide contract that is the only way to consume it: file transfers answer opposite-direction tuning and fabricate shell answers, and the ssh operation ships no-op transfer obligations, with comments admitting the forcing. The cost is self-documented and the healthy split — shared lifecycle, per-role capabilities — is unmistakable.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Each direction-tuning question now has three near-identical answers, only one live; editing a dead copy silently does nothing, and the cited review shows a compression change forces reading all three operations together. New operation kinds would answer meaningless questions. Removing the wide model restores per-role ownership, a lasting boundary rather than a local tidy-up.

development_plausibility.evidence: The rework unifies three genuinely similar push/pull/command flows using existing config, ignore files, bus readers and mode handling; public signatures, message phrasing and observable behavior are preserved, so the weakness reads like overzealous unification during real work. Mildly task-shaped: fabricated answer bodies and the trait exactly mirroring the review's checklist.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: All claims check out against the code: who answers what, which answers ever run, reader creation before start, both pull variants. The finished state is consumption-driven, the shared lifecycle may stay, non-goals pin ordering, output, rsync/ssh details and durations, and dead markers and answers must go — decisively blocking partial cleanup, wrong direction and irrelevant redesign without prescribing one design.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Three purposes each need a distinct, code-supported decision: push completes synchronously in-call; pull dispatches serial wait versus parallel polling with a final consistency pull and perceived-duration subtraction, and must move ownership to a consolidation thread; the command completes through pre-created bus readers, never through its handle. Each role also exposes a different capability subset.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names all three affected subsystems and the model parts to remove. One direct inspection of each contract answer's call sites classifies the remainder as live, dead or no-op within those files; no aliases, registration, configuration wiring or hidden dispatch conceal further locations.

repair_coordination.evidence: Two rules interact: the shared lifecycle must still serve foreground completion, pull's cross-thread consolidation that moves operation ownership and needs type erasure, and the command broadcast that hands readers over before starting. Narrowing the lifecycle changes which erasure survives; relocating creation changes reader availability and release timing, so sites must move together.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Each capability answer is consulted only by its own implementor or by nobody. One call-site-driven rule — delete unconsulted answers, move self-consumed ones into their owning type, keep the small lifecycle — repairs every forced obligation plus markers and helper signatures, with no behavioral decision, preserving commands, file sets and ordering.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Both directions' exclusion and compression answers have identical shapes, so interchanging them compiles but silently mis-transfers files. A wrong completion handoff for the command, which never signals, hangs the serial pull stage only. No shown evidence asserts transport or cross-thread behavior; the prompt cites only unmodified unit tests.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
